headlines.title: Federal Reserve complacency over US inflation risks looks wrong
Jump in Consumer Prices Raises Stakes in Inflation Debate
headlines.abstract: The increase in the Labor Department’s Consumer Price Index was well above forecasts. A top Fed official acknowledged the surprise but said, “This is one data point.”
